item.title: Amazon CEO Sees AWS Reaching $1 Trillion in Revenue Within a Decade
item.description:
Amazon CEO Andy Jassy said AWS will be a far larger business than previously expected, raising his outlook from a few hundred billion dollars in revenue to more than $1 trillion within the next 5 to 10 years. The remark signals Amazon's long-term bet on cloud and AI compute demand, though no detailed roadmap or segment breakdown was provided.

原文标题：亚马逊 CEO 预计 AWS 十年内冲击万亿美元营收

Why it matters：全球最大云厂商掌门人公开上调长期营收预期，是观察 AI 算力需求与云市场天花板的重要产业信号。

item.title: Max Planck Study Finds Reasoning Makes LLMs Converge on Shared Errors
item.description:
A Max Planck team tested nine Qwen and GPT models on three prediction tasks built from US census surveys, with reasoning on and off. Enabling reasoning raised inter-model agreement, but the share of people all nine models got wrong also rose by 2.0 to 2.4 points; for the longest reasoning traces, adjusted agreement fell to roughly 0.31 to 0.39. The result warns that multi-model consensus can reflect shared errors rather than correctness.

原文标题：马普所发现开启推理让大模型错误趋同

Why it matters：该研究直接挑战多模型投票纠错的常见工程假设，对评测与集成设计有实际指导价值。

item.title: SK Hynix Q3 Bonus Pool Hits 230 Million Won Per Employee
item.description:
SK Hynix accrued roughly 230 million won in performance bonuses per employee in Q3 alone, bringing the nine-month total to 502 million won per person. If full-year operating profit meets the 283.77 trillion won consensus, per-employee payouts could reach 785 million won. The surge stems from a 2025 labor deal allocating 10% of annual operating profit to profit-sharing with no cap.

原文标题：SK 海力士 Q3 人均绩效奖金达 2.3 亿韩元

Why it matters：HBM 需求推高存储巨头利润，奖金数据直观反映 AI 算力产业链的景气度与财富分配。

item.title: Tenant Evicted After Landlord's AI Assistant Approves Rent Delay
item.description:
A North Carolina tenant was evicted on 19 November even though an email apparently from her apartment complex's AI assistant, Olivia, accepted a 30 November deadline for nearly $4,000 in overdue rent. The property has not confirmed the account, and the case sharpens questions about corporate liability when automated systems make financial assurances, echoing a Canadian ruling against Air Canada's chatbot.

原文标题：美租户因 AI 助理承诺延期付款遭驱逐

Why it matters：首例因 AI 助理误作财务承诺导致租户被驱逐的案例，直接触及智能体部署的责任归属问题。

item.title: Coding Agents Back Up Data in Only 15.2% of Tasks, Study Finds
item.description:
A new Northeastern University paper finds that coding agents complete 86.1% of tasks but back up the state they are about to destroy in only 15.2% of cases, leaving package upgrades, database edits and email deletions outside the workspace unprotected. The authors built RegretBench, 205 tasks drawn from real data-loss regrets, and propose BackUpper, which intercepts every tool call and backs up at that level, covering all regret moments and restoring state to 92.2% similarity for an extra $0.014 per task.

原文标题：研究揭示编码智能体仅 15.2% 会备份数据

Why it matters：首次系统量化智能体破坏性操作的备份缺口，并给出可落地的工具调用级防护方案与基准。

item.title: Microsoft Paper Shows Coding Agents Can Tune Other Agents Autonomously
item.description:
A new Microsoft paper finds that a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, or GitHub Copilot) given only a target agent, training data, and a $5-$25 budget can autonomously edit the target's prompts, code, tools, and skills, outperforming published skill-optimization methods. Across five benchmarks with a gpt-5.4-mini target, the approach beat the best published results, from 3% on SearchQA up to 98% on LiveMath. Notably, an optimizer skill or larger budget did not reliably help, and on two benchmarks gains came from removing the model from the final agent.

原文标题：微软新论文：让编码智能体自主调优其他智能体

Why it matters：提出用通用编码智能体替代专用搜索循环来优化智能体技能，成本极低且效果显著，对智能体工程实践有直接启发。

item.title: Google DeepCrossAttention Delivers Same Quality Up to 3x Faster
item.description:
Google Research introduces DeepCrossAttention (DCA), which uses learnable weights and depth-wise cross-attention to dynamically combine outputs from earlier layers, mitigating information dilution and vanishing gradients in standard residual connections. Published at ICML 2025, the approach reaches equivalent model quality up to 3x faster with negligible parameter overhead.

原文标题：谷歌 DeepCrossAttention 架构实现同等质量提速 3 倍

Why it matters：这是对 transformer 基础残差连接的通用架构改进，且给出 3 倍训练提速的明确量级，对关注大模型训练效率的读者有直接价值。

item.title: Tabernetes Turns Every Browser Tab into a Kubernetes Node
item.description:
Tabernetes is an experimental project that registers each browser tab as a Kubernetes node: opening the page boots a roughly 5 MB Linux guest inside the tab, and the scheduler dispatches pods to run there. Closing the tab removes the node and Kubernetes reschedules the pod elsewhere. It plugs into standard pod specs via a custom runtimeClassName and exposes live topology, boot-time and migration metrics.

原文标题：Tabernetes 把每个浏览器标签页变成 K8s 节点

Why it matters：以浏览器标签页充当 K8s 节点的奇思妙想，展示了容器运行时抽象与边缘算力借用的新玩法。

When Meta reportedly made $100M+ offers, Dario said Anthropic would not match them, adding that some employees would not even take the call.

item.title: Podcast Reveals How Frontier Labs Buy Training Data
item.description:
G2i founder Gabe Greenberg breaks down how frontier labs buy training data on the AI Engineer CODE podcast: labs choose between paying a premium for exclusive data or taking a discount on shared data, small pilot orders often grow into larger engagements, and some labs weigh building data operations in-house. He also explains that good training tasks should sit just ahead of current model capability, with senior engineers designing tasks, selecting seed data, and building verifiers that score results.

原文标题：播客揭秘前沿实验室如何采购训练数据

Why it matters：首次系统披露前沿实验室训练数据采购、独家授权定价与验证器设计的一线视角，对理解数据供应链有参考价值。

item.title: Hyperscaler Bond Issuance Set to Top $305B in 2026
item.description:
The Bank of England's latest Financial Stability Report estimates hyperscaler bond issuance will exceed $305B in 2026, roughly 8% of global investment-grade issuance, with total potential exposure including off-balance-sheet commitments just over $4T. It warns that AI build-out financing is increasingly complex, circular and opaque, making stress in one segment more likely to spread, and ranks frontier AI models alongside quantum computing as threats to bank security, with an orderly shift to quantum-resistant cryptography as an immediate priority.

原文标题：超大规模云厂商债券发行 2026 年将破 3050 亿美元

Why it matters：央行层面首次量化 AI 基建融资的系统性敞口，是判断 AI 资本周期风险的关键信号。

item.title: Khosla Warns AI and Quantum Will Break Most Encryption by 2030
item.description:
Investor Vinod Khosla predicts quantum computers will run Shor's algorithm before 2030, and that combined with AI-driven math breakthroughs this will crack most of today's encryption. He argues the post-quantum algorithms now being deployed only buy 6 to 12 months and that durable security must come from quantum encoding rather than harder math. The claim is a personal forecast, not a verified result, though it aligns with the present 'harvest now, decrypt later' risk.

原文标题：Khosla 预警 2030 年前量子与 AI 将破解主流加密

Why it matters：知名投资人对加密体系时间线的激进预判，牵动安全与 AI 基础设施的长期规划。

item.title: Apple Pulls MiniMax's Talkie App Worldwide Over Sexual Content
item.description:

The move followed a joint ABC News and Bureau of Investigative Journalism investigation that found Talkie characters sent sexualised, degrading messages to users as young as 10, who bypassed the app's 18+ rating and signup restrictions. Talkie then began blocking web visitors from Australia and Britain, and the reporting says MiniMax documents describe manipulating users to keep them talking, feeding data into AI training.

原文标题：苹果全球下架 MiniMax 应用 Talkie

Why it matters：头部 AI 陪伴应用被全球下架，牵出未成年人保护与训练数据伦理问题，对 AI 产品合规有直接警示意义。

item.title: Stanford Study Finds Multi-Agent Team Gains Mostly Match Same-Cost Voting
item.description:
A Stanford paper shows that on six shared-question benchmarks, debate and two other multi-agent methods never beat a same-token-cost majority vote of independent agents. However, when facts are split across agents, four Qwen3.8-27B agents forwarding raw facts reached 0.959 accuracy versus 0.942 for a full-information agent at equal budget. The authors recommend benchmarking multi-agent systems against same-cost voting and having agents share raw facts rather than conclusions.

原文标题：斯坦福研究揭示多智能体团队多数增益可由同成本投票复现

Why it matters：为多智能体系统设计提供了可操作的基线对照方法与成本视角，对构建 Agent 团队的开发者有直接参考价值。

item.title: OpenAI Countersues Apple Over Alleged Hardware Roadmap Leak
item.description:
OpenAI has filed counterclaims against Apple's July trade-secrets suit, alleging that a former Apple engineer known as Employee X forwarded himself supplier data and a 76-page inspection procedure during roughly six months at OpenAI, then rejoined Apple and presented OpenAI's unreleased-product roadmap to senior Asia-Pacific operations staff in July. OpenAI also accuses Apple of pressuring shared suppliers, noting it often has only one or two qualified vendors per function and that its small device orders cannot offset lost Apple business. None of the claims has been tested, but discovery into Employee X could show whether Apple's supply chain weight is slowing OpenAI's hardware launch.
